Fifth pre-release of 2.4 — **duplicates**.

## New

- **Edit > Find duplicates …** (Library): finds the same book more than once — same Calibre ID, same ISBN, same title and author, or the same file content (a copy under another name). Books linked that way form one group, e.g. an EPUB, its KEPUB and a copy.
- Each copy shows folder, format, size, date, read status, chapters and cover. Nothing is preselected: check what you want to delete; every file is backed up first, and collections that contained a deleted copy get the kept one instead.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.4-beta5.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
